title: Rational molecular engineering of porphyrins for enhanced performance in dye-sensitized solar cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2369-2379
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00043B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Faraghally A. Faraghally, Yu-Hsuan Chen, Tsung-Zu Lee, Yan-Da Chen, Tzu-Chien Wei, Chen-Yu Yeh
A novel series of nine porphyrin dyes have been synthesized to explore structure–performance relationship, in which the impact of a donor's bulkiness and diverse acceptors are investigated. Among these porphyrin dyes, TZ1 achieved a PCE of 9.90%.
